purpose: Cross-workstream convention and dependency contract, not a complete action or established theory

units.apparatus: SI; explicit conversion required at interface

reference_action.schematic: S = integral sqrt(-g) [Mbar_P^2 R/2 + L_SM + (partial phi)^T(partial phi)/2 - V(phi,H) + L_curvature + L_higher_operators]
reference_action.potential: V = V_SM(H) + phi^T M0^2 phi/2 + (phi^T K phi) HdaggerH/2 + lambda_abcd phi_a phi_b phi_c phi_d/4!
reference_action.quartic_tensor: Fully symmetric; five independent components for two real scalars; values unspecified
reference_action.scope: Only the quadratic portal interface is fixed here. Curvature, higher operators, counterterms and renormalization are unfinished.
reference_action.interpretation: Field labels do not establish psychological or ethical meanings; E_phys is not E_norm without an operational bridge.

symmetric_branch.symmetry: simultaneous Z2: phi -> -phi; individual sign flips generally not symmetries
symmetric_branch.kinetic_normalization: positive identity in this low-energy tree branch
symmetric_branch.basis_rule: Under phi=Q psi, transform M^2, K, all quartics, sources and operators consistently; field redefinition is not a physical symmetry claim.
symmetric_branch.single_scalar_photon_operator: Forbidden by exact simultaneous Z2; a broken-vacuum branch needs fresh matching

thermal_benchmark.bath: Ideal Maxwell-Boltzmann e,mu,tau,u,d,s,c,b; no claim of complete QCD thermodynamics
thermal_benchmark.initial_state: Imposed scalar Maxwell-Boltzmann population at T=0.5 GeV; continuation scans alter preparation, not earlier cosmology

tree_interfaces.diagonal_width: Gamma_ii = v^2 Kii^2 sqrt(1-4 mi^2/mh^2)/(32 pi mh), only for 2 mi < mh
tree_interfaces.mixed_width: Gamma_12 = v^2 K12^2 sqrt([1-(m1+m2)^2/mh^2][1-(m1-m2)^2/mh^2])/(16 pi mh), only for m1+m2 < mh
tree_interfaces.width_status: Production only; each lifetime, decay branch, acceptance, and total Higgs width is required for an invisible prediction
tree_interfaces.point_probe_matching: C = fa ma K_mass/(2 mh^2), [C]=GeV^-1; |q^2| << mh^2
tree_interfaces.probe_Hamiltonian: H_int = - integral d^3x n_a(x) (s^T C s)_renormalized
tree_interfaces.field_equation_source: (Box I + M^2)s = 2 n_a C s + ...; multiplicative mass shift, zero remains a solution
tree_interfaces.conditional_stationary_noise_matrix: For O_ij=(s_i s_j)_ren, use S_B=sum_ijkl C_ij C_kl S_(ij)(kl), including both off-diagonal orderings; gamma(d)=S_B(0,0)-Re S_B(0,d) under the same stationary heavy-probe assumptions
tree_interfaces.noise_fourier_convention: S_AB(Omega,r)=integral over all real t of exp(i Omega t) <delta A(t,r) delta B(0,0)>; at Omega=0 use the equal symmetrized spectrum; no extra factor two
tree_interfaces.detector_scope: Stationary heavy point probe, weak coupling, specified stationary bath, controlled Markov limit; extended moving detector needs response and finite-time filter

source_archive.general_bridge_principle_pages: 6457-6468; this contract implements rather than originates that architecture

claim_gate: No workstream may use a null dependency as a measured or derived value. Numerical verification certifies specified computations, not the existence or interpretation of the fields.
